meta: Your child keeps asking why? By the tenth time, parents are stuck. AI helps you explain at the right age level, short and simple.

muc.title: The tenth why
muc.text: Your child asks why the sky is blue, then why again, and by the tenth time you're stuck. AI helps you answer at their level.

muc.title: Say how old they are
muc.text: Tell AI your child's age and ask it to explain in two or three sentences, comparing to familiar things at home.

muc.title: Guess the next question
muc.text: Ask AI to guess three follow-up whys with short answers, so you're not caught off guard.

muc.title: Health questions go to the doctor
muc.text: AI can still be wrong; for your child's health, ask the doctor. Looking it up in books together is a good lesson too.

muc.title: Your latest why
muc.text: Take your child's latest why question and ask a chatbot to answer it for a five-year-old in three sentences.
